from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from nicegui_base.governance.release_artifacts import verify_wheel, verify_wheel_public_api, verify_wheel_source_representation

root = Path('source').resolve()
wheel = root / 'wheel/nicegui_base-3.0.0a8-py3-none-any.whl'
wheel_report = verify_wheel(wheel)
api_report = verify_wheel_public_api(wheel, python_executable=sys.executable)
source_report = verify_wheel_source_representation(root, wheel)
if not (wheel_report.passed and api_report.passed and source_report.passed):
    raise SystemExit(f'wheel authority inputs failed: {wheel_report} {api_report} {source_report}')

source_representation = {
    'compared_files': source_report.compared_files,
    'mismatches': list(source_report.mismatches),
    'missing_from_source': list(source_report.missing_from_source),
    'missing_from_wheel': list(source_report.missing_from_wheel),
    'root': '.',
    'status': 'PASS' if source_report.passed else 'FAIL',
    'wheel': 'wheel/nicegui_base-3.0.0a8-py3-none-any.whl',
}

wheel_integrity_path = root / 'WHEEL_INTEGRITY.json'
wheel_integrity = json.loads(wheel_integrity_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
wheel_integrity.update({
    'isolated_root_api_entries': api_report.export_count,
    'isolated_root_api_sha256': api_report.export_sha256,
    'record_hashes_verified': wheel_report.record_hashes_verified,

    'record_rows': wheel_report.record_rows,
    'sha256': wheel_report.sha256,
    'size_bytes': wheel_report.size_bytes,
    'source_representation_compared_files': source_report.compared_files,
    'source_representation_status': 'PASS' if source_report.passed else 'FAIL',
})
wheel_integrity_path.write_text(json.dumps(wheel_integrity, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\\n', encoding='utf-8')

wheel_verification_path = root / 'WHEEL_VERIFICATION_WAVE77.json'
wheel_verification = json.loads(wheel_verification_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
wheel_verification.update({
    'isolated_no_deps_import': 'PASS' if api_report.passed else 'FAIL',
    'isolated_root_api_entries': api_report.export_count,
    'isolated_root_api_sha256': api_report.export_sha256,
    'metadata_name': wheel_report.metadata_name,
    'metadata_version': wheel_report.metadata_version,
    'record_hashes_verified': wheel_report.record_hashes_verified,
    'record_mismatches': wheel_report.record_mismatches,
    'record_rows': wheel_report.record_rows,
    'requires_dist': list(wheel_report.requires_dist),
    'production_requires_dist': [item for item in wheel_report.requires_dist if 'extra ==' not in item],
    'sha256': wheel_report.sha256,
    'size_bytes': wheel_report.size_bytes,
    'source_representation': source_representation,
    'status': 'PASS' if wheel_report.passed and api_report.passed and source_report.passed else 'FAIL',
})
wheel_verification_path.write_text(json.dumps(wheel_verification, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\\n', encoding='utf-8')

batch = json.loads((root / 'TEST_BATCH_EXECUTION.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
test_report = json.loads((root / 'TEST_REPORT.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
coverage = json.loads((root / 'LIVE_COMPONENT_COVERAGE.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
phase77_collect = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '--collect-only', '-q', 'tests/test_phase77_v300a8_final_release_candidate_consolidation.py'],
    cwd=root, env={**os.environ, 'PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD': '1'}, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
)
phase77_tests = int(re.search(r':\\s*(\\d+)\\s*"'$'"', phase77_collect.stdout.strip(), re.MULTILINE).group(1))
manifest_path = root / 'RELEASE_MANIFEST.json'
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
manifest['generated_at'] = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z')
manifest['final_wheel'].update({
    'public_api_entries': api_report.export_count,
    'public_api_sha256': api_report.export_sha256,
    'record_hashes_verified': wheel_report.record_hashes_verified,
    'record_mismatches': wheel_report.record_mismatches,
    'record_rows': wheel_report.record_rows,
    'sha256': wheel_report.sha256,
    'size_bytes': wheel_report.size_bytes,
    'source_representation': 'PASS' if source_report.passed else 'FAIL',
})
source_zero = manifest['source_zero_regression']
source_zero.update({
    'automated_tests': test_report['automated_tests'],
    'fresh_process_batches': f\"{batch['batches_executed']}/{batch['batches_requested']} PASS\",
    'test_files': batch['test_files'],
    'visual_integration_coverage': f\"{coverage['covered_visual_components']}/{coverage['required_visual_components']}\",
    'wave77_behavioral_tests': phase77_tests,
})
manifest['wave77'].update({
    'fresh_process_batches': batch['batches_executed'],
    'public_root_api_entries': api_report.export_count,
    'public_root_api_sha256': api_report.export_sha256,
})
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({
    'wheel_sha256': wheel_report.sha256,
    'wheel_size_bytes': wheel_report.size_bytes,
    'record_rows': wheel_report.record_rows,
    'record_hashes_verified': wheel_report.record_hashes_verified,
    'api_entries': api_report.export_count,
    'api_sha256': api_report.export_sha256,
    'source_representation': source_representation,
    'automated_tests': test_report['automated_tests'],
    'test_files': batch['test_files'],
    'fresh_process_batches': batch['batches_executed'],
    'phase77_behavioral_tests': phase77_tests,
    'visual_coverage': f\"{coverage['covered_visual_components']}/{coverage['required_visual_components']}\",
}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
PY"
